envelope.description: Add readAssignee and setAssignee to the adapter

body.title: Add readAssignee and setAssignee to the adapter
body.summary: Implement readAssignee (single assignee, null when none, rejected for more than one or a malformed reference) and setAssignee (read the current assignees, remove every other assignee, add the requested one or clear all for null, re-read and compare, report a partial or unknown outcome as rejected or unreachable without retrying) using gh issue edit and gh issue view.
acceptanceChecks: setAssignee from zero, one (same user), one (another user) and several assignees ends with exactly the requested set, verified by the re-read
setAssignee makes no change call when the set is already right and clears every assignee for null
A differing re-read or a step that times out is reported as rejected or unreachable and no step is retried
readAssignee returns rejected for more than one assignee or a malformed reference without calling gh

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: readAssignee returns the single login, null when unassigned and rejected for several or a malformed reference
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: setAssignee from zero, one and several assignees ends with exactly the requested user
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: setAssignee makes no change call when already right and clears for null
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: setAssignee reports rejected or unreachable without a retry when the re-read differs or a step times out
